title: Frequently Asked Questions
lead: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.q: Can I see a demo before committing?
items.a: Yes. Every prospective customer gets a personalized live demo with our team, tailored to your industry and use case. No credit card required, no commitment - just a conversation about whether Inovexa fits your needs.

items.q: Can I switch plans at any time?
items.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. Your dedicated account manager handles the transition.

Our implementation team handles your full data migration from your current system - whether it's spreadsheets, another ERP, or a legacy accounting system. We've migrated from SAP, Sage, QuickBooks, and dozens of custom systems. Migration is included in all plans.

items.q: Does Inovexa handle local tax rules in my country?
items.a: Yes. The tax engine is configurable per country. We support Tunisian TVA, Moroccan VAT, Egyptian e-invoicing, and European VAT, and add new jurisdictions based on customer demand. Rates are updated as regulations change.
Inovexa supports French and English across all modules and system-generated documents (invoices, reports, contracts). Language can be set per user.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: You own your data 100%. Upon cancellation, you'll receive a full export of all your data in standard formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, PDF). We retain data for 90 days after cancellation before permanent deletion.

Yes - on-premise deployment is available on the Enterprise plan for organizations with data sovereignty requirements or limited internet connectivity. Contact our sales team for specifications and pricing.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.a: Contract terms are flexible and discussed during your custom quote. Annual subscriptions typically include preferred pricing; month-to-month options are also available. Contact our team for details specific to your plan.

c: Still have questions? We're happy to help.
